differences.en: This page runs the mock communication agent, planner, skills, and evidence gate inside the browser. It does not call a chat-completions model.
differences.zh: 这个页面在浏览器里运行模拟模式的沟通代理、规划代理、技能和证据门，不会调用对话模型。

differences.en: Catalog, policy, and shipment tools run in-process on the synthetic snapshots. There is no MCP child process and no network call to a store or carrier.
differences.zh: 商品、政策和物流工具在页面进程内读取合成快照。没有 MCP 子进程，也不会访问商店或承运商。

differences.en: Session memory uses in-memory SQLite and an in-memory cache. MySQL and Redis are not used. Reset clears them.
differences.zh: 会话记忆使用内存中的 SQLite 和内存缓存。不使用 MySQL 或 Redis。新对话会清空它们。

differences.en: The separate local Python server can use a configured model endpoint. This page never contacts that server and has no place to enter an API key.
differences.zh: 另外的本地 Python 服务可以连接已配置的模型端点。这个页面不会访问那个服务，也没有填写密钥的入口。

differences.en: The page uses the built-in default settings. It ignores SHOPASSIST environment variables and the local settings file. The local server still applies those.
differences.zh: 页面使用内置默认设置，忽略 SHOPASSIST 环境变量和本地设置文件。本地服务仍会读取它们。

differences.en: The page sends the sentence shown on each shortcut. Chinese questions such as 这个商品多少钱 are parsed directly. Catalog category ids such as drinkware stay in English.
differences.zh: 快捷按钮发送的就是按钮上的那句话。这个商品多少钱这类中文问题会直接解析。目录里的品类 id 如 drinkware 仍是英文。

differences.en: Nothing here places an order or takes payment. Shipment answers describe the synthetic snapshot only.
differences.zh: 这里不能下单，也不能付款。物流回答只描述合成快照。

differences.en: Knowledge search on this page uses the prebuilt hashing lexical baseline shipped with the static files. It is not a semantic embedding and it is not a live vector database or MCP process.
differences.zh: 本页的知识检索使用随静态文件发布的哈希词面索引。它不是语义向量，也不是在线向量库或 MCP 进程。

en.text: How much is the Blue stoneware mug 350 ml?

zh.text: Blue stoneware mug 350 ml 多少钱？

purpose.en: Price and stock for the item opened from the product page.
purpose.zh: 核对从商品页带进来的这件商品的价格和库存。

limits.en: Uses the consulted product in the session. The snapshot name stays English.
limits.zh: 用会话里正在看的商品。快照里的商品名仍是英文。

purpose.en: Ask whether that same item is in stock.
purpose.zh: 询问同一件商品是否有货。

limits.en: Stock comes from the quote, not from the page address.
limits.zh: 库存来自报价，不来自网址。

purpose.en: Search the drinkware category under a budget.

limits.en: The category id drinkware is English in the snapshot.
limits.zh: 品类 id drinkware 在快照里是英文。

samples.en: compare Matte ceramic mug 350 ml and Blue stoneware mug 350 ml
samples.zh: 对比 Matte ceramic mug 350 ml 和 Blue stoneware mug 350 ml

limits.en: Both names must be the snapshot names.
limits.zh: 两个名字都必须是快照里的英文名。

purpose.en: Read the current return window from the fixture policy.
purpose.zh: 读取夹具政策里的现行退货时限。

limits.en: This is the shared fixture note, not a promise from a carrier or a per-item rule.
limits.zh: 这是共享的夹具说明，不是承运商承诺，也不是单件商品规则。

purpose.en: Read a known synthetic tracking id.
purpose.zh: 查询合成快照里存在的单号。

limits.en: TRK-OK is synthetic. It is not a live carrier lookup.
limits.zh: TRK-OK 是合成单号，不是实时承运商查询。

purpose.en: Ask for a tracking id that is absent from the snapshot.
purpose.zh: 查询快照里没有的单号。

limits.en: An empty snapshot is not a carrier saying the shipment does not exist.
limits.zh: 快照为空不等于承运商否认这票货。

purpose.en: Retrieve a fictional membership note from the hashing index.
purpose.zh: 用哈希索引检索虚构的会员说明。

limits.en: The score is a hashing cosine, not a semantic relevance score. The prefix is required.
limits.zh: 分数是哈希余弦，不是语义相关度。需要这个前缀。

en.title: Northline demo
en.banner: Deterministic demo · synthetic catalog · no checkout
en.welcome: Hello. You opened this chat from the product page. I can check this item's price and stock, and the return note, using the synthetic catalog.
en.pace_note: Pauses are only for reading. The time on a turn is the measured run, not the pause.
en.no_checkout: This demo cannot place an order.
en.reset_done: Chat reset. You are back on the item you opened.
en.unknown_product: That product id is not in the snapshot. No price or stock is shown.
en.unsupported: I can answer price, stock, and the return window for the item you are viewing. Other questions need one of the supported sentences.
en.price_line: This item is {price} {currency}, with {stock} in stock.
en.returns_line: The current return window is {days} days for unused items.
en.no_match: Nothing in the snapshot matches that request.
en.several: These items matched. Prices and stock are from the snapshot.
en.trace_empty: Open this after a question to see the route, skill, and evidence gate.

limitations.logistics_not_in_snapshot: That tracking id is not in the snapshot. This is not a carrier saying the shipment does not exist.
limitations.logistics_unavailable: No usable tracking status came back.

shipment.present: Status below is from the synthetic snapshot.
shipment.empty: The snapshot has no record for that id.

zh.title: 澄选演示
zh.banner: 确定性演示 · 合成目录 · 不能下单
zh.welcome: 你好。你是从商品页进来的。我可以用合成目录核对这件商品的价格、库存和退货说明。
zh.pace_note: 停顿只是为了阅读。回合上的时间是实际运行时间，不是停顿。
zh.boot_sqlite: 正在加载本地目录存储。
zh.reset_done: 对话已重置，回到你进来时的商品。
zh.unknown_product: 快照里没有这个商品编号，所以不显示价格或库存。
zh.unsupported: 我可以回答你正在看的商品的价格、库存和退货时限。其他问题需要用支持的句子。
zh.returns_line: 现行退货时限是 {days} 天，适用于未使用的商品。
zh.no_match: 快照里没有符合这个请求的结果。
zh.several: 这些商品符合条件。价格和库存来自快照。
zh.trace_empty: 提问之后打开这里，可以看到路由、技能和证据门。

limitations.logistics_not_in_snapshot: 快照里没有这个单号。这不是承运商证明货物不存在。
limitations.logistics_unavailable: 没有得到可用的物流状态。
limitations.no_match: 没有符合已确认条件的结果。
limitations.retrieval_miss: 没有查到可引用的事实。

shipment.present: 下面的状态来自合成快照。
